summary: Loads the default profile icon BMP. Reads a custom icon path override at this+0x158; when null falls back to the default application directory byte_5EA438. Loads via sub_497AD0 on the loader sub-object at this+0x40, retrying with the default icon path aProfileiconDft when the first load returns null. Stores the loaded object through ObjectFieldInitWithIndirectLookup into the field at this+73 dwords, then reports success (argument 1) or failure (argument 0) through the virtual notification at vtable offset 0x3C and returns the field pointer on success, null on failure.

operations.description: Read the custom icon path override from this+0x158 (86th dword).
When the override path is null, fall back to the default application directory byte_5EA438.
Attempt to load the BMP through sub_497AD0 using the loader sub-object at this+0x40 with the chosen path and flags 0.
When the first load attempt returns null, retry with the default profile icon path aProfileiconDft.
Second load attempt through sub_497AD0 on the same loader sub-object at this+0x40 with aProfileiconDft and flags 0.
Store the loaded object through ObjectFieldInitWithIndirectLookup into the profile-icon field at this+73 dwords (byte offset this+0x124).
Branch on the loaded-object handle at this+0x144 (81st dword): non-zero selects the success path, zero the failure path.
Success path: invoke the virtual notification at vtable offset 0x3C (60) with argument 1, reading the vtable pointer at this+0x0.
Success path: return this + 292, the address of the initialized profile-icon field.
Failure path: invoke the same virtual notification at vtable offset 0x3C with argument 0, reading the vtable pointer at this+0x0.

clean_pseudocode: if (path == NULL) path = byte_5EA438;       // default app directory
